$comment: Contract for workspace/reports/harness_reach_dynamic.json, written by scripts/harness_reach.py dynamic (record_dynamic): per harness module, the gate's entry points the fuzz corpus executed (from the coverage report or reproducible fuzz crash artifacts) and those it never did (`gaps`), with the digest of the harness measured. Rows merge across runs; a module whose coverage was missing or unusable gets a row only when its reproducible crashes prove every entry point executed (`measured_by` crashes); a module with left-over unreplayed inputs (`inputs.not_replayed` > 0) gets no row (an earlier row is dropped), only its reason under `unmeasured` (dropped once it is measured). harness_reach.py check (apply_dynamic) keeps a gap failing while the harness digest is unchanged.

entry_points_crashed.$comment: total entry points across measured modules proven executed via reproducible fuzz crashes

unmeasured.$comment: module -> why its coverage could not be measured (run_dynamic's error)

warnings.$comment: schema problems the producer recorded (validate_artifacts.schema_warning); run-dir fails on them

crashed_entry_points.$comment: entry points with 0 coverage counts proven executed by reproducible fuzz crash artifacts

crash_notes.$comment: on a row with gaps: why reproducible fuzz crashes credited no further entry point (an artifact found under another harness or case count, a custom or sequence case, a failure an init helper also reaches); at most 20 plus a count

failed_inputs.$comment: inputs that crashed the coverage replay when every input was replayed (inputs.failed); the reach stands

measured_by.$comment: `crashes` when the module had no usable coverage report and its reproducible fuzz crashes proved every entry point executed (run_dynamic); absent when the coverage report measured it
